steps_basic.title: Open Scratch and click Create
steps_basic.instruction: Open Scratch and click Create. You should see the Stage and a sprite (cat).
steps_basic.hint: If you can't see the cat, refresh Scratch.

steps_basic.title: Delete or rename the Cat
steps_basic.instruction: Delete the Cat sprite (right-click → delete) OR keep it and rename it 'Buddy' (sprite name box).
steps_basic.hint: Right-click on the cat sprite and choose delete, or just rename it to Buddy.

steps_basic.title: Select Buddy sprite
steps_basic.instruction: Click Buddy so it is selected (blue outline).
steps_basic.hint: Click on the sprite in the sprite list at the bottom right.

steps_basic.title: Add 'when this sprite clicked' event
steps_basic.instruction: Events → drag 'when this sprite clicked' into the coding area.
steps_basic.hint: Look in the Events category (yellow blocks).

steps_basic.title: Add say block
steps_basic.instruction: Looks → drag 'say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds' and snap it under the event.
steps_basic.hint: Looks category → say [ ] for ( ) seconds block.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Test your character
steps_basic.instruction: Click Buddy on the stage to test. Buddy should speak!
steps_basic.hint: Click on Buddy in the stage area (big white area on the right).
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Do BASIC first
steps_standard.instruction: Complete all BASIC steps before starting STANDARD level.
steps_standard.hint: Make sure you have the basic talking character working.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Add a second costume
steps_standard.instruction: Costumes tab → add/duplicate a second costume (so you have costume1 and costume2).
steps_standard.hint: Click Costumes tab, then hover over a costume and click the duplicate icon.

steps_standard.title: Add more say blocks
steps_standard.instruction: Back to Code → add two more 'say [ ] for ( ) seconds' blocks (3 total).
steps_standard.hint: Looks → say [ ] for ( ) seconds. Drag it 2 more times.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds
say [How are you?] for (2) seconds
say [Nice to see you!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Insert costume change
steps_standard.instruction: Insert 'switch costume to [costume2]' between message 1 and message 2.
steps_standard.hint: Looks → switch costume to. Put it after the first say block.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds
switch costume to [costume2 v]
say [How are you?] for (2) seconds
say [Nice to see you!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Choose a sound
steps_standard.instruction: Sounds tab → choose a sound (e.g., Pop).
steps_standard.hint: Click Sounds tab → click speaker icon → choose Pop or any sound.

steps_standard.title: Add sound effect
steps_standard.instruction: Sound category → add 'start sound [Pop]' after the last message.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds
switch costume to [costume2 v]
say [How are you?] for (2) seconds
say [Nice to see you!] for (2) seconds
start sound [Pop v]

steps_standard.title: Test all features
steps_standard.instruction: Test: click Buddy → message1 → costume change → message2 → message3 → sound.
steps_standard.hint: The costume should change and you should hear a sound at the end.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds
switch costume to [costume2 v]
say [How are you?] for (2) seconds
say [Nice to see you!] for (2) seconds
start sound [Pop v]

steps_advanced.title: Do STANDARD first
steps_advanced.instruction: Complete all STANDARD steps before starting ADVANCED level.
steps_advanced.hint: You should have costume changes, multiple messages, and sound working.

steps_advanced.title: Make a Variable 'message'
steps_advanced.instruction: Variables → Make a Variable → name it 'message' (for all sprites).
steps_advanced.hint: Click Variables category → Make a Variable button.

steps_advanced.title: Set random message
steps_advanced.instruction: Operators → add 'pick random (1) to (3)'. Variables → 'set [message] to (pick random 1 to 3)' near the top of the script.
steps_advanced.hint: Put this right after 'when this sprite clicked'.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))

steps_advanced.title: Ask for user's name
steps_advanced.instruction: Sensing → add 'ask [What is your name?] and wait'.
steps_advanced.hint: Put this after setting the message variable.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))
ask [What is your name?] and wait

steps_advanced.title: Join name with greeting
steps_advanced.instruction: Operators → drag 'join [Hello ] (answer)'. Put it into Looks → 'say (join...) for (2) seconds'.
steps_advanced.hint: Operators → join. Sensing → answer. Combine them.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))
ask [What is your name?] and wait
say (join [Hello ] (answer)) for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Add if-then for message 1
steps_advanced.instruction: Control → add 'if then' → inside say reply #1.
steps_advanced.hint: Control → if then. Put your first response inside.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))
ask [What is your name?] and wait
if <(message) = (1)> then
  say (join [Hello ] (answer)) for (2) seconds
  say [Great to meet you!] for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Add else-if for messages 2 and 3
steps_advanced.instruction: Add else-if (or nested if) for message=2 and message=3 with different replies.
steps_advanced.hint: Click + on the if block to add else. Create different responses for each number.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))
ask [What is your name?] and wait
if <(message) = (1)> then
  say (join [Hello ] (answer)) for (2) seconds
  say [Great to meet you!] for (2) seconds
else
  if <(message) = (2)> then
    say (join [Hi there, ] (answer)) for (2) seconds
    say [Welcome!] for (2) seconds
  else
    say (join [Hey ] (answer)) for (2) seconds
    say [Nice name!] for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Test random responses
steps_advanced.instruction: Test: click Buddy several times—replies should change randomly.
steps_advanced.hint: Each time you click, the greeting should be different (1, 2, or 3).
